candidate_parameterization: Three uniform-gain probe profiles; fit each slot independently, composing at most 3^6 profiles. One-hot patterns make probes separable. No semantic/timing change.

receiver.model: max(0, rendered_slot * latent_multiplier + independent Gaussian noise). Lapse => unknown; else peak < detection => zero; else top-two margin < ambiguity => unknown; else peak slot and threshold level.
receiver.assumption: A fixed nominal one-hot codebook with intensities 0.25/0.5 is already known. This is an assumption, not learning evidence.

allocation.warmup: Every direction x candidate x nonzero level once, in direction/candidate/level order; catches included in budget.
allocation.uniform: Repeat direction/candidate/level order excluding every 13th catch.
allocation.selective: After warmup choose direction maximizing baseline-gain posterior error / sqrt(number of nonzero responses for that direction). Then least-sampled candidate, then least-sampled level.
allocation.tie_rules: Direction index ascending; candidate order 1.0,0.75,0.5; level 1 then 2. Catch uses base profile and code zero.

fit.rule: For each slot minimize mean posterior error across levels 1/2, with independent Beta(1,1) estimates per candidate/level. Catch trials excluded from gain fitting, but costed. Ties prefer gain 1.0 then 0.75 then 0.5.

evaluation.codes: 12 direction/level codes plus zero, each 32 repetitions; unknown is incorrect even for zero; zero correct only for zero.
evaluation.cost: number of calibration responses; reference costs zero; no human time inference
evaluation.freeze: All methods and budgets select profiles before any evaluation for that individual/scenario; evaluator has no selector/fitter callback.
evaluation.summary: Per seed/scenario/budget and paired selective-minus-uniform / calibrated-minus-reference; per-code confusion; split-level mean, sample SD, min/max, win/tie/loss counts. Descriptive synthetic individuals, no human inference.

randomness.draws: Each keyed random.Random uses one uniform lapse draw then six Gaussian draws, drawn regardless of lapse. Full SHA-256 of canonical JSON keys seeds each local generator. No global RNG.
randomness.boundary: Selector/fitter receive only immutable catalogue and prior query/command/response observations, plus remaining budget for selector. They never receive key, seed, scenario, latent state, RNG, future responses or evaluation data.

freeze_note: Written before any v1 development/check evaluation. No check-driven tuning; any bug rerun of exposed check seeds must be disclosed.
